messages.text: Heads up, I'm starting the quarterly counterparty limit review this afternoon. Pulling current exposure vs. approved limits from RiskEngine now. Will post the breach/near-breach list by end of day.

Thanks Phillip. Can we make sure the review covers the prime brokers and the two regional dealers where we've been growing repo volume? Board risk committee is next week and I want to walk in with no surprises.
Yes, both are in scope. Repo dealers are the ones I'm most watching. Utilization on one of them is sitting around 88% of its limit on a PFE basis.
Quick flag: RiskEngine intraday exposure numbers looked a bit stale around 14:30 on a couple of the dealer netting sets. Probably a pricing refresh lag but worth checking before we lock anything in.
I saw that too. The netting set for the larger dealer didn't update for about 20 min. I'll rerun the exposure snapshot and compare to the 14:00 baseline.
88% is higher than I'd like. What's the driver, collateral haircuts or just notional growth?
Mostly notional growth. Desk added term repo in July. Haircuts are unchanged. Margin call thresholds are also tighter on their side, so it's not a collateral shortfall issue.
Reran. Delta is small, about 1.2% on the larger dealer once the refresh landed. Utilization moves from 88% to roughly 89%. Nothing that changes the ranking.
Good. Still, I'd note the lag in the review memo as a data-quality caveat. Market risk numbers feed the PFE inputs so any stale price could understate exposure.
Are we proposing any limit increases, or holding flat? If someone's asking for more headroom I'd want to see the credit rationale and rating outlook first.
Trading has requested a bump on the smaller regional dealer, from $150M to $200M. I'm leaning toward a partial increase to $175M with a review in 90 days, pending Lance's credit write-up.

Write-up is mostly done. Financials are solid, capital ratios up QoQ, but there's some concentration in CRE lending. I'd support $175M with a covenant-style trigger if their outlook gets revised negative.
That's reasonable. I'm comfortable with $175M and the trigger. Please document the CRE concentration point explicitly in the committee pack.
Separately, ReportingBI is still showing last month's limit table on the counterparty dashboard. Anyone know if the refresh job is scheduled for this weekend?
I believe it's tied to the overnight load, so it should refresh Saturday morning. I'll check Monday and screenshot the updated view for the pack either way.
Draft exceptions list is up in the shared folder. Three near-breaches, no hard breaches. Please review over the weekend if you can and send comments by Monday noon.
Will do. Thanks all, good work getting this together before the committee.
